{{Quote|Careful with this guy. He's got a rather nasty reputation. Name's Wedu Belar and he's a pretty good shot too.|Zekka Thyne|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Wedu Belar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] under [[Shalera]] the Hutt. Belar was killed by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[Zekka Thyne (Bothan)|Zekka Thyne]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SlicerMaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Wedu Belar]]
[[File:SlicerFemTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated female depictions, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Wedu Belar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

Wedu Belar spawned under eight possible Human depictions, four male, and four female. Because the quest dialogue identified Belar as male, this article assumes one of the four Human male depictions is canon.
